plan-for-reading-a-key-from-the-registry.text: Plan for reading a key from the registry address.

Issue 744. This page is for the people who implement and review the pull requests. It binds the model, the rulings, the pull requests and their slices, the open questions and the seats. The story and the requirements are in the specification; the checks are in the gate.

lean-binding.text: Lean is the authority. The code takes the models' vocabulary: PublishedRelease, Preimage.active, activeAsset, stateAsset, recognizeState, trieGet, Leaf.unknown, State.active, State.terminal, open datum's liveShape and its termination request shape.

No Lean declaration states what a reader may conclude from an observation, and issue 741 left its observation tasks to this ticket. Whether this ticket adds those statements is the first open question. If it does, the first pull request adds them; the reader's classification code then binds to them by name.

rulings-in-force.text: Registry identity (issue 741 decisions, approvals bind the complete registry asset identity): a registry is its state policy and its state token name; the registry address of issue 728 spells exactly these two with the network.

Reader starting point (epic owner, answer A-001 to the essay rewrite, 2026-10-24): the reader starts from the registry identity as the registry address spells it; absence of a token is not proof the key is unused.

Hashed names (ruling 2026-10-23, CBOR preimages): the active token's name is the hash of the CBOR preimage of the active role, the registry identity and the key; the reader computes it with the shared preimage codec.
Application-held termination (2026-10-23): a pending termination's request and token stay at the application's script.
The provider is the chain entry point (2026-10-20): every chain read goes through the session; a reader works from a web page, Koios and a wallet, with no local file.
The trie library's proofs are assumed sound.

pull-requests-and-slices.text: Each slice finishes in well under two hours with its own RED evidence and checkpoints; the commit owner may cut a slice smaller, never merge two. Pull request 2's first two slices do not depend on either open question and start first.

consumers-to-run-before-the-first-push.text: Consumers to run before the first push.
a provider-layer change reaches open datum, conformance and node confinement: their tests run in the gate;
a new command reaches help snapshots, parser corpora, the documented flags check and the command reference;
a release table change reaches the table's freshness check and its control;
a Lean change reaches the models' check inventories, audits and their recipes.

seats.text: Operator, 2026-10-28, as issue 743's team: Claude Opus 5.5 high ticket owner; commit owner Codex gpt-6.1-sol high; commit auditor Muse xhigh, mute and persistent, in a read-only audit worktree. No other seats. The auditor writes its own gate table when seated; the ticket owner joins the two once and freezes the result before the commit owner starts.
